# Sertuin Events

> Official first-party information about private marriage proposal experiences and event services in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.

Sertuin Events organizes complete, all-inclusive marriage proposal experiences on its private beach in Uvero Alto. The official proposal page is the primary source for current package names, published prices, inclusions, photographs and booking information.

Sertuin Events is operated by Sertuin SRL, a registered Dominican company based in Punta Cana and led by wedding planner Grecia Mejía. The company has more than 10 years of experience and has created more than 1,800 marriage proposals. Consultations and in-person meetings are available by prior appointment; the company does not offer walk-in office service.

## Primary service pages

- [Punta Cana proposal packages](https://sertuinevents.com/proposal/): English overview, current packages and prices, inclusions, reservation process, real work and frequently asked questions.
- [Propuestas de matrimonio en Punta Cana](https://sertuinevents.com/es/proposal/): Spanish version of the proposal service page.
- [XML sitemap](https://sertuinevents.com/sitemap-index.xml): Discover all current service and individual package URLs.

Each package card on the proposal page links to an independent detail page under `/packages/`. Those pages contain the package-specific description, current price, included items, photographs, available additions and inquiry form. Package-specific information is managed in Contentful and should be treated as the current source of truth.

## Service facts

- Experiences take place on Sertuin Events' private beach in Uvero Alto.
- Published proposal package prices include private round-trip transportation from any hotel or accommodation throughout Punta Cana, with no zone surcharge.
- Private beach access has no separate mandatory rental or venue fee.
- The selected romantic setup, a celebratory beverage, professional photography, the client's preferred song and a dedicated on-site coordinator are included.
- Clients receive more than 70 professionally edited, high-resolution photographs within 48 hours.
- The actual proposal is also recorded on a phone at no additional cost.
- Optional upgrades can include cinematic video and drone coverage, live musicians, a private dinner, cold sparks and custom flowers.
- A US$200 deposit reserves the date and is deducted from the total. A written service agreement and secure PayPal payment link are provided. The remaining balance is paid after the experience according to the agreement.
